question: The SI Unit of heat is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Joule.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Joule__ is the SI unit of heat.
 
• Heat is a form of energy transfer due to temperature difference.
 
• It is measured in terms of energy units.
 
• The joule is also used to measure other forms of energy, such as mechanical and electrical energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Units of Heat:**

 
 
• Calorie: A unit of heat energy used in thermodynamics and nutrition.
 
• BTU (British Thermal Unit): Commonly used in heating and cooling systems.
 
 
 
• **Relation with Work and Energy:**
 
 
• Work, heat, and energy are interrelated and measured in joules.
 
• Heat is the energy transferred between systems or objects due to temperature differences.
